_meta.description: VG150 predicate semantic map for fine-to-coarse collapse analysis

confidence_levels.strong: clear semantic entailment or phrase inclusion; eligible for the main experiment
confidence_levels.medium: semantically related but not strict entailment; extension analysis only
confidence_levels.weak: debatable, context-dependent, or only visually correlated; appendix only or excluded

sitting on.evidence: lexical entailment (phrase-includes 'on') + visual support/contact relation + sitting posture modifier
sitting on.notes: Core on-family child. sitting on = on + sitting posture.

standing on.evidence: lexical entailment (phrase-includes 'on') + visual support/contact relation + standing posture modifier
standing on.notes: Core on-family child. standing on = on + standing posture.

lying on.evidence: lexical entailment (phrase-includes 'on') + visual support/contact relation + lying posture modifier
lying on.notes: Core on-family child. lying on = on + lying posture.

laying on.evidence: lexical entailment (phrase-includes 'on') + visual support/contact relation; variant spelling of lying on
laying on.notes: Core on-family child. laying on = alternative form of lying on.

walking on.evidence: lexical entailment (phrase-includes 'on') + visual support/contact relation + walking action modifier
walking on.notes: Core on-family child. walking on = on + walking action.

parked on.evidence: lexical entailment (phrase-includes 'on') + visual support/contact relation + parked state modifier
parked on.notes: Core on-family child. parked on = on + parked state.

mounted on.evidence: lexical entailment (phrase-includes 'on') + visual support/contact relation + attachment semantics
mounted on.notes: Core on-family child. mounted on = on + mounted/attached state.

covered in.notes: Core in-family child. covered in = in + coverage state.

growing on.evidence: phrase-includes 'on' + surface attachment relation, but growth semantics make strict spatial entailment debatable
growing on.notes: Extended on-family. Plant growth involves biological attachment, not just physical support.

painted on.evidence: phrase-includes 'on' + surface relation, but painting involves application/coating semantics beyond simple support
painted on.notes: Extended on-family. Surface marking rather than pure support/contact.

flying in.evidence: phrase-includes 'in' + containment relation, but flying action adds dynamic semantics not captured by 'in' alone
flying in.notes: Extended in-family. Action-in-containment vs. static containment.

walking in.evidence: phrase-includes 'in' + containment relation, but walking action adds dynamic semantics not captured by 'in' alone
walking in.notes: Extended in-family. Action-in-containment vs. static containment.

riding.evidence: spatial support often present, but agentive/control semantics and vehicle/animal context make strict entailment debatable
riding.notes: Agentive on-family. Riding implies active control, not just spatial support.

on back of.evidence: phrase-includes 'on' + support relation, but specific anatomical location makes entailment more specific than general 'on'
on back of.notes: Location-specific on-family. 'On back of' entails on but also specifies body part.

hanging from.evidence: spatial support may exist but direction/preposition differs ('from' vs 'on'); suspension semantics differ from surface support
hanging from.notes: Direction-different. 'Hanging from' implies suspension from above, not support from below.

wearing.evidence: wearing implies possessing/having an object on the body, but involves specific body-attachment semantics beyond simple possession
wearing.notes: Interaction-to-association. Not strict entailment; visually correlated body-object relationship.

wears.evidence: same as wearing (tense variant); implies having an object on the body
wears.notes: Tense variant of wearing. Same semantic relationship.

carrying.evidence: carrying implies possessing/holding during transport, but involves active transport semantics beyond simple possession

holding.evidence: holding implies possessing/having in hand, but involves active grasp semantics beyond simple possession

part of.evidence: part-of implies meronymic relationship, which is related to possession but uses different semantic frame (composition vs ownership)
part of.notes: Meronymy-to-association. Part-of is compositional, not possessional.

in front of.evidence: in-front-of implies proximity but specifies directional orientation; 'near' loses direction information
in front of.notes: Directional-to-proximity weakening. Direction is semantically significant.

behind.evidence: behind implies proximity but specifies rear orientation; 'near' loses direction information
behind.notes: Directional-to-proximity weakening. Direction is semantically significant.

under.evidence: under implies proximity with vertical ordering; may include contact/support; 'near' loses vertical and contact information
under.notes: Directional-to-proximity weakening. Vertical axis is semantically significant.

above.evidence: above implies proximity with vertical ordering; 'near' loses vertical information
above.notes: Directional-to-proximity weakening. Vertical axis is semantically significant.

over.evidence: over implies above/across position; may partially imply proximity but spatial specificity is lost

against.evidence: against implies contact + proximity, but contact semantics are stronger than mere proximity
against.notes: Contact-to-proximity weakening. Contact is semantically significant.

across.evidence: across implies spanning/transverse relation with possible proximity; spatial specificity is lost with 'near'

along.evidence: along implies parallel/lateral proximity; spatial configuration is lost with 'near'
along.notes: Positional-to-proximity weakening. Parallel configuration is significant.
